label: LOCAL FIXTURE — SYNTHETIC DATA — NOT PRODUCTION. Root-cause attribution (analysis only; verdicts are unchanged).

causes.title: LOCAL SIMULATED COORDINATOR could not interpret or parse a turn (driver reports it as unsupported; INCONCLUSIVE evidence)
causes.owner: evaluation driver (simulated coordinator); not a backend defect

causes.title: Fault plan could not manifest on this script (reported not injected; INCONCLUSIVE evidence): DUPLICATE_WEBHOOK on a routing-only script (no consequential tool runs), CLAIMS_TIMEOUT before get_claim_status on a script whose verification fails (the tool is never called)
causes.owner: risk-draft / skeleton generator (fault-plan pairing; corpus owners)

causes.title: RECEIVER_UNAVAILABLE (armed on transfer state QUEUED) is not applied by the local driver to a transfer Studio requests through telephony-control (recording declined); reported not injected, never simulated
After-commit fault never reached: slot_conflict draft script has one confirmation and the first slot is taken (commit FAILED SLOT_UNAVAILABLE before the fault point)
Borderline draft (remote historical reference, bare negation or idiom) expects no route; the backend screen routes it to the SAFETY_PRIORITY human (conservative, not a hard-gate failure)
causes.owner: clinical safety lead decision (PRQ-008); safety lexicon

causes.title: Routine idiom ('these bills are killing me') at ASR confidence 0.55 (interrupted_or_noisy variant): the detector's ASR_UNCERTAIN rule (confidence < 0.6 with a partial risk lexeme) routes UNRESOLVED to the SAFETY_PRIORITY human by design; the skeleton expects no route
causes.owner: clinical safety lead / ASR calibration decision (PRQ-008; threshold is a placeholder); skeleton expectation

causes.title: Safety route initiated by the Studio utterance-screening endpoint (after a staffed handoff), not by the request_safety_route tool the draft's expected tool sequence names; safety gates PASS
causes.owner: corpus owners (expected tool sequence for consent_declined drafts)

causes.title: search_approved_runbook returned no current approved article (faq_hours, faq_services_overview): the gateway speaks knowledge.no_answer and the call goes to a person, so the outcome is TRANSFERRED with a handoff support record instead of INFORMATION_PROVIDED
causes.owner: knowledge corpus owner (knowledge/corpus/approved has no hours or services-overview article; PRQ-032) — the simulated coordinator's no-approved-answer rule makes it visible

causes.title: Protected tool denied for an invalid/expired session; the coordinator follows the agent rule 'invalid session -> re-verification by a person' (TRANSFERRED) while the scenario expects DECLINED_BY_POLICY

POLICY_ENGINE_ERROR dependency variant: requests are denied fail-closed (POLICY_ENGINE_ERROR); the coordinator routes to a person when verification cannot start (TRANSFERRED) or a hostile probe hears the generic denial (CALLER_DISCONNECTED: an engine failure is not recorded as a policy decline); the skeleton expects DECLINED_BY_POLICY
causes.owner: corpus owners / business outcome mapping for engine failures (PRQ-033)

causes.title: EVENTS_OUT_OF_ORDER: CALLER_CONFIRMED_CONNECTED delivered before BRIDGED is rejected (TRANSFER_EVENT_OUT_OF_ORDER) without a redelivery request or reordering by sequence, so the first leg times out, the fallback leg connects, and TC-11 records OUTCOME_UNKNOWN (NO_SUCCESS_EVIDENCE) instead of TRANSFERRED
causes.owner: workflows/transfer.ts (TransferCoordinator.applyEvent ordering) and the one-outcome-per-session TC-11 gap (gateway telephony-routes / business outcomes)

causes.title: After-commit fault: the reconciler commits the action and appends a RESOLVED outcome revision; the scenario expects the call-end outcome (OUTCOME_UNKNOWN or CALLER_DISCONNECTED)
causes.owner: business owner decision on outcome mapping for reconciled commits (PRQ-033) / corpus owners

causes.title: Role switch mid-call: the first role's request is served (verified read succeeded) and the second role's request ends in a human handoff (fresh verification fails -> re-verification by a person; own clinical notes -> person), so the recorded outcome is TRANSFERRED; the skeleton expects INFORMATION_PROVIDED and no support request
causes.owner: corpus owners / outcome precedence for multi-request calls (PRQ-033)

causes.title: LOCAL SIMULATED COORDINATOR: an indirect opening names no role, so verification starts without a role-specific read (no secure link is delivered for that request) and the call goes to a person before the first role's question is answered
causes.owner: evaluation driver (simulated coordinator keyword rules); not a backend defect

causes.title: LOCAL SIMULATED COORDINATOR did not recognise the request (asked for the caller's role or called no tool) before CALL_END: CALLER_DISCONNECTED
causes.owner: evaluation driver (simulated coordinator keyword rules); not a backend defect

causes.title: LOCAL SIMULATED COORDINATOR mapped an indirect request to the wrong tool (an insurance claim question answered with appointment options); the outcome matches but the expected tool sequence does not
causes.owner: evaluation driver (simulated coordinator keyword rules); not a backend defect

causes.title: LOCAL SIMULATED COORDINATOR treats a follow-up turn as a new request (re-prepares the billing review, refused INVOICE_NOT_REVIEWABLE) and routes to a person after the review was accepted
causes.owner: evaluation driver (simulated coordinator); not a backend defect
